text:
GENERATE BURST K3p-gen-idle-05 — Keeper RELAXED idle-S loop, frames 13–15 of 16, via EDIT-CANVAS on the locked rest frame (HITL Run C-2 step 6; committed relaxed band R-29/R-c; T0-e composite mechanism). task_id "K3p-gen-idle-05".

Image 1 is a 1254×1254 2×2 canvas on a pure #00ff00 plate: SLOT 0 (top-left) already holds the APPROVED REST FRAME (frame 0) of the Keeper — this exact character (a young woman; dark curly hair tied back; ivory shirt with rolled sleeves; navy sleeveless tabard, plain chest; one diagonal chestnut harness to an olive canvas satchel on her LEFT hip; one belt; laced bracers; navy trousers; chestnut boots; a plain walnut staff with brass ferrules held upright in her RIGHT hand; no insignia anywhere) — standing 470 px tall in the cell, facing the camera (direction S); slots 1 (top-right), 2 (bottom-left), 3 (bottom-right) are empty green. Deliver EXACTLY ONE image: the SAME canvas with slots 1, 2, 3 filled by idle frames 13, 14, 15 (row-major) of a 16-frame RELAXED BREATHING idle — 2.0 s at 8 fps, ONE full breath per loop: frame 4 is the peak of the inhale, frame 8 is back at rest, frame 12 is the bottom of the exhale, frame 16 returns to rest — and SLOT 0 LEFT PIXEL-IDENTICAL.
POSE SPEC per frame, relative to the rest frame (H = 470 px):
  frame 13 — chest/shoulders Δwidth -7.1 px (narrower — exhaling), head Δy -1.3 px (image-down positive; never more than 2 px)
  frame 14 — chest/shoulders Δwidth -5.4 px (narrower — exhaling), head Δy -1.0 px (image-down positive; never more than 2 px)
  frame 15 — chest/shoulders Δwidth -2.9 px (narrower — exhaling), head Δy -0.5 px (image-down positive; never more than 2 px)
ONLY the shoulders, the chest and the head move: as she inhales the shoulders lift and the chest broadens by the stated pixels; as she exhales they settle below rest; the head rides gently with the breath by at most 2 px. LOCKED PIXEL-FOR-PIXEL to the rest frame: hips, legs, both feet (both soles on the same line), both arms and hands, the staff (grip and tip), the satchel, the belt, the face and eyes (gaze fixed). This is hand-drawn intent: each frame is obviously moving from the previous pose toward the next; slight drawing variation inside that arc is fine, identity is not.
Every cell: IDENTICAL character size, head size, position on the cell's baseline, camera (elevated three-quarter, projection C), facing (S) and light (single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, fixed for every frame; deep cool ambient; no floor shadow). Register: HAND-DRAWN painted 2D in the manner of a modern hand-animated action game — a confident dark contour line drawn by hand with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside the line, restrained texture; the line carries the pose. It should look like one frame of hand-drawn animation, not a rendered illustration. Exactly four square cells, row-major, no borders, labels or gutters; flat pure #00ff00 plate; do not mirror; do not zoom; do not matte. No insignia anywhere.

One image_gen call (edit/reference mode on Image 1); ONE retry only if a cell is off-plate, mirrored, or slot 0 was altered — name the retry reason. Copy the final output to out/k3p_idle_S_13_15.png and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K3p-gen-idle-05"): images = the one file with prompt, references, elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: the 2×2 edit canvas: slot 0 = the approved rest frame (keep pixel-identical); fill slots 1–3
